verdict.rationale: The closest evidence is `doctor workspace`, a read-only diagnostic that exits nonzero when it finds an actionable topology problem. That loosely checks whether a workspace is set up for YYLO's agent orchestration, and read-only preflight before task start adds a little more. Nothing documents a report that actually scores how ready a repository is for autonomous agents. Missing for 10: a dedicated agent-readiness report or score, defined readiness criteria (tests, docs, agent instructions, CI), report output format, and independent corroboration.
